emotional_tone: Professional, authoritative, intelligent, clear, analytical, and confident.
visual_mood: Swiss typography, high-contrast monochrome with strategic color accents, stark white background, crisp borders, 'Control Room' grid.

rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-heading font-medium tracking-tight text-gray-900

layout.structure: Full-height workstation application. A sidebar for history on the left. The main area divided into a two-column split pane (Input vs Results) on desktop. Dense, data-heavy but clearly sectioned with 1px borders.
layout.borders: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Elements are separated by hard 1px borders instead of margins/shadows.
layout.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders for separation. No elevation or soft dropshadows.

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-300 rounded-none hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors

Professional avatar placeholder for logged-in user profile

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. The primary blue #002FA7 on white exceeds this easily.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a sharp focus ring: focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#002FA7] focus-visible:ring-offset-1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required fonts: Cormorant Garamond, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts.
Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette, font families, and disable border-radius on major components.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn rounded corners or shadows. Strip them out in favor of hard lines and flat colors.
For the main layout, build a full-screen dashboard (h-screen) with a fixed sidebar for history, and a flexible right area containing the main workspace.
The workspace should ideally be a split view: left side for raw input notes and right side for the tabbed results.
Render the LLM output using a markdown renderer (like react-markdown), ensuring the typography rules are applied to the rendered HTML.
Ensure the 'Clean & Standardise' button has a prominent presence, utilizing the International Klein Blue.
Apply data-testid to every button, tab, and input element.
For the gap analysis section, utilize the error (#EF4444) and warning (#F59E0B) colors strategically for flagged contradictions or missing edges.
